name: cpdrift
description: Batch-correction methods for image-based cell profiling are benchmarked transductively, fitted on every batch including the ones they are scored on. Production screens are inductive: plates accumulate over months and a correction must be applied to batches that did not exist when it was fitted. cpdrift provides a deployment-semantics taxonomy separating methods that expose a fit/transform split from those offering only a whole-matrix entry point, a Procrustes-gauged measure of how far already-analysed profiles move when later batches arrive, and evaluation metrics reporting batch mixing and biological retrieval together.
